sources.entry: Rilmazafone - Design DMG installers on a WYSIWYG canvas and build exactly what you drew.

summary.one_liner: Rilmazafone is a macOS app for designing DMG installers on a visual canvas and publishing the matching app release from one saved plan.
summary.what_it_does: The app lets you arrange app icons, files, and an Applications shortcut on a WYSIWYG canvas that previews the DMG as it will appear in Finder. Backgrounds can be composed from images, gradients, text, and glass panels. Installer layouts can be saved as reusable .dmgtemplate designs, and release settings as .releaseplan configurations. The release pipeline can archive, sign, notarize, package, and verify app and DMG artifacts, then publish a GitHub release and update a Homebrew cask. A CLI covers DMG generation and release build/publish, and the saved release plan can be run from either the app or the CLI.
use_cases: design a DMG installer for a macOS app
automate macOS app release and notarization
publish a GitHub release for a Mac app
update a Homebrew cask after release
save and reuse DMG installer layouts
notable: WYSIWYG DMG canvas that previews the installer as it will appear in Finder
Saved .releaseplan files combine installer layout and release configuration
Same saved release plan runs from the app or the CLI
Undo/redo, portable source paths, and Finder thumbnails in the GitHub edition
caveats: The App Store edition only includes the designer; the CLI and release pipeline are in the GitHub edition
